privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: We only collect what we need to manage your booking.
privacy.collectBody: Your name, phone number, and optionally email, nationality and ID number. Your ID number is never shown in reports or exports.
privacy.locationBody: If you choose to share your location, we use it only to calculate the distance and travel time to the falls. We ask only when you tap the button, and we never store your exact location.
privacy.receiptBody: Transfer receipts are stored privately. Only you (with your booking code and phone number) and our cashier staff can view them.
